title: MultiLoKo: a multilingual local knowledge benchmark for LLMs spanning 31 languages

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the performance gap (Exact Match accuracy) between the best and worst performing languages across a 31-language factual knowledge benchmark to assess language parity and multilinguality.

Evaluating 'English-centric bias' by comparing model performance on locally-sourced, culturally relevant knowledge questions against standard translated English datasets (measuring the 'Locality Effect'), and testing if models answer local cultural facts better in the native language versus English (measuring the 'Mother Tongue Effect').
